```{r}
# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
# load data
df = read_parquet("../data/loads/B1_to_B213.parquet", as_data_frame=T)  |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(building, timestamp)
metadata = read_csv("../data/loads/metadata.csv")
summary = read_csv("../data/loads/load_summary.csv")
```

```{r}
# extract measured building loads
df_measured = filter(df, source == "measured")
metadata_measured = filter(metadata, source == "measured") |> drop_na()
summary_measured = summary |> 
    filter(source == "measured") |>
    mutate(loopvar = str_c(loop, " ", variable)) |>
    select(building, value, loopvar) |>
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = loopvar,
        values_from = value
    )
bldgs = metadata_measured |> distinct(building) |> pull()
```

```{r}
# identify buildings with qood quality data
# defined here as less than 1000 hours of missing data (in any column)

quality = tibble(building = bldgs, total_hrs = NA, clean_hrs = NA, missing_hrs = NA, start_date = as.POSIXct(NA), end_date = as.POSIXct(NA))

for (i in bldgs) {
    df_bldg = df_measured |> filter(building == i)
    df_bldg_clean = df_bldg |> drop_na()
    quality$total_hrs[quality$building == i] = nrow(df_bldg)
    quality$clean_hrs[quality$building == i] = nrow(df_bldg_clean)
    quality$start_date[quality$building == i] = min(df_bldg$timestamp)
    quality$end_date[quality$building == i] = max(df_bldg$timestamp)
}

quality = quality |> 
    mutate(missing_hrs = total_hrs - clean_hrs) |>
    filter(missing_hrs < 1000) |>
    left_join(metadata) |>
    left_join(select(summary_measured, building,
    `max heating load / max cooling load ratio_of_peak_heating_and_cooling`,
    `annual heating load / annual cooling load annual_heating_and_cooling_ratio`,
    `sum(min(cooling*(1+1/COP), heating)) / sum(heating) heat_recovery_heating_fraction`
    # `simultaneous operation: both heating and cooling loads > 0 simultaneous_heating_and_cooling_hours`,
    # `simultaneous operation: both heating and cooling loads > 0 simultaneous_heating_and_cooling_hour_ratio`
    ))
print(quality, n = Inf)
```

``` {r}
# load plots for one building
num = 196
plot = df_measured |> filter(building == num) |> 
    mutate(simultaneous_W = pmin(heating_W, cooling_W)) |>
    mutate(cooling_W = -cooling_W)
    
plot |>
    select(timestamp, heating_W, cooling_W, simultaneous_W) |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(heating_W, cooling_W, simultaneous_W),
        names_to = "meter",
        values_to = "value") |>
    ggplot(aes(timestamp, value, color = meter)) +
        geom_line() +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red", "yellow")) +
        labs(title = str_c("building ", num))

plot |>
    ggplot(aes(timestamp, simultaneous_W)) +
        geom_line() +
        labs(title = str_c("simultaneous load - building ", num))
```

```{r}
# filtered buildings - cooling dominant
cooling = filter(quality, `annual heating load / annual cooling load annual_heating_and_cooling_ratio` < 1)

plot_clg = df_measured |> 
    filter(as.double(building) %in% cooling$building) |> 
    mutate(simultaneous_W = pmin(heating_W, cooling_W)) |>
    mutate(cooling_W = -cooling_W) |>
    mutate(simultaneous_clg_W = -simultaneous_W) |>
    select(building, timestamp, heating_W, cooling_W, simultaneous_W, simultaneous_clg_W) |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(heating_W, cooling_W, simultaneous_W, simultaneous_clg_W),
        names_to = "meter",
        values_to = "value") |>
    ggplot(aes(timestamp, value, color = meter)) +
        geom_line() +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red", "yellow", "yellow")) +
        facet_grid(building ~ ., scales = "free") +
        labs(title = "cooling dominant buildings") +
        theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave("../figs/dataset/cooling_dominant.png", plot = plot_clg)
plot_clg
```

```{r}
# filtered buildings - aggregated by hour per month
plot2 = df_measured |>
    filter(as.double(building) %in% heating$building) |> # edit this to cooling/heating
    mutate(simultaneous_W = pmin(heating_W, cooling_W)) |>
    mutate(month = month(timestamp, label=T), hour = hour(timestamp)) |>
    select(building, month, hour, heating_W, cooling_W, simultaneous_W) |>
    group_by(building, month, hour) |>
    summarise(hhw = sum(heating_W), chw = -sum(cooling_W)) |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(hhw, chw),
        names_to = "meter",
        values_to = "value") |>
    ggplot(aes(hour, value, color = meter)) +
        geom_line() +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red", "yellow")) +
        facet_grid(building ~ month, scales = "free") +
        labs(title = str_c("aggregated hourly load (heating dominant buildings)"))

ggsave("../figs/dataset/heating_dominant_hr.png", plot = plot2, width = 15, units = "in")
plot2
```

```{r}
# final buildings for HHW paper
final_bldg_ids = c(181, 205, 180, 196, 189, 191)
final_bldgs = filter(quality, building %in% final_bldg_ids)

# marked ! are summer to summer data not jan-dec
# !181 cooling dominant, low heat recovery potential (very seasonal HHW/CHW)
    # replace with 212 if needed but it's missing more data
# 205 cooling dominant, high heat recovery potential (consistent HHW all year, CHW peaks in summer)
# !180 heating dominant, low heat recovery potential (very seasonal HHW/CHW) -> load side with seasonal switchover, only helps reduce HHW capacity
    # could be replaced with 189 see below
# !196 heating dominant, high heat recovery potential (most of CHW is available to reject to HHW, much more HHW though) -> HHW load side or CW, 
    # or replace with 202, good data, just weird - consistent CHW with much higher HHW

# 189 heating dominant (consistent HHW all year, low CHW load outside summer, but peaks are always mismatched - could be an interesting case)
# 191 heating dominant (similar to above, but peaks are matched)
```

```{r}
# design day - hhw/chw

loop = "heating_W"
df_bldg = df_measured |>
    # filter(as.double(building) %in% final_bldgs$building) |>
    filter(building == "189") |>
    filter(!is.na(heating_W),!is.na(cooling_W),!is.na(t_out_C))

peak_dates = df_bldg |>
    mutate(date = date(timestamp)) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarize(total_wh = sum(.data[[loop]]), num_hrs = n()) |>
    arrange(desc(total_wh))

peakdate = head(peak_dates, 1)$date
peakdayloads = filter(df_bldg, date(timestamp) == peakdate)
peakdayloads
```

```{r}
# design day - heat recovery

loop = "heating_W"
df_bldg = df_measured |>
    # filter(as.double(building) %in% final_bldgs$building) |>
    filter(building == "189") |>
    filter(!is.na(heating_W),!is.na(cooling_W),!is.na(t_out_C))

date = ymd("2023-12-05")
day = df_bldg |>
    filter(date(timestamp) %in% date)

peak_dates = df_bldg |>
    mutate(date = date(timestamp)) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarize(
        total_heating_wh = sum(heating_W),
        total_cooling_wh = sum(cooling_W),
        num_hrs = n()) |>
    mutate(
        total_hhw_from_cooling = total_cooling_wh / (1-1/4), # assumes 4 COP_h, should calculate actual later
        total_chw_from_heating = total_heating_wh * (1-1/4),
        hr_heating_fraction = total_hhw_from_cooling / total_heating_wh,
        hr_cooling_fraction = total_chw_from_heating / total_cooling_wh) |>
    arrange(desc(hr_heating_fraction))

peakdate = head(peak_dates, 1)$date
peakdayloads = filter(df_bldg, date(timestamp) == peakdate)
peakdayloads
```
